items.title: Suspected fraudulent banking-change notice from Triforest
items.summary: An email claiming to be Triforest Inc. ('Important Notice: Update to Triforest Inc. Banking Information') arrived at info@ addressed to Triforest's own address rather than info@ — a classic vendor-email-compromise pattern. Titan has a real, active payment relationship with Triforest (a $2,992.83 Interac transfer went out Sept 18), which makes this a plausible targeted attack. Do not update any payment/banking records from this email; verify by phone using a known number first.
